data.narrative:
Observable Space is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Dan Roelker and Rick Hedrick, having raised $90M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the same sector and development stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $180M from the $90M raised proxy. Peer-median anchoring across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B Seed)—produces a $1.3B implied valuation, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of Observable Space's revenue on file, though the public Space & Aerospace median trades at 24.6x price-to-sales across the five public tickers.

Triangulating the two applicable methods yields a valuation range of $153M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $740M. The wide range reflects tension between stage-based progression, which anchors to capital deployed, and peer comparables, which capture the heterogeneous values assigned to frontier aerospace ventures at nearby development stages. Key uncertainties include Observable Space's revenue trajectory relative to peers and the degree to which recent private-market multiples in the sector sustain forward.
